title: Figure 3: Planar metamaterial unit cells (OE1-OE6) and their complements (CE1-CE6)
description: Twelve-panel grid of planar metamaterial unit-cell geometries: six original metallic patterns labeled OE1-OE6 on a grey background (left) and their slot-based complements CE1-CE6 on a yellow background (right). Patterns include split-ring, cross and circular resonator shapes, with E and H field polarization arrows marked in OE1 and CE1. Caption: "Figure 3. Geometry of Original Planar Metamaterial Unit Cells (OE1-OE6) and Their Complements (CE1-CE6)." Appears below text and an equation for the electric response of metamaterials.
